notes: Draft list for Tom's approval. group = the perspective a source speaks from (used for framing divergence); owner = state | public | private | intergovernmental | ngo. domains tag GDELT articles with the same groups, so outlets without a usable feed still count. rss_status: active (polled) | candidate (retry) | dropped (reason in rss_note) | none (GDELT only). expected_minutes = normal gap between new items, calibrated from the 26 Oct probe. clock_skew_hours = hours to subtract from a feed that labels local time as UTC. format: telegram = a public channel's web preview (t.me/s/<channel>), parsed by pipeline/telegram.py. Front-line sources added 27 Oct 2026 (Tom); two-source rule: an indicator hit counts once two independent sources report it (different outlets, not both from the same government).
